scope: Translate retained expansion scout-device class admission and trap/conceal scaling onto Publish 14.1 professions and skill modifiers without making the retired NGE Spy profession, player combat level, or ranger_trap modifier authoritative elsewhere.

findings: Publish 14.1 Scout grants the trapping modifier from novice through the tools branch and master; Ranger requires Master Scout and adds tracking, conceal, camouflage, and a trapping support branch.

The authenticated Publish 14.1 implementation resolves trap use with the trapping modifier and Ranger concealment with camouflage; it does not use player combat level or the later ranger_trap modifier.

Retained expansion scout-device templates encode the later Spy profession as class ID 5. Ranger is the closest Publish 14.1 advanced profession for this item-only tracking, camouflage, and trapping role.
The item-only translation must not make Rangers identify as NGE Spies in quests, conversations, profession displays, or other gameplay systems.
